title: When the Summer Breaks
author: Bram Pemberton
blurb: Gideon Eastwick, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
